skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Breaking the Ice
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Breaking the Ice. Operator Frostleaf's attire during her special appointment by the Rhodes Island Columbia branch to conduct a search and rescue in the nation's north. Life has bestowed her the resolve to return to the battlefield.
skins.usage: One of Frostleaf's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'People are still sending children onto the battlefield? Got it, I'll handle this rescue mission.'
